issue.title: plugin: a request's body is base64-encoded again for the host at 4x, and the queue it waits in counts entries rather than bytes
issue.body:
**Found by an AI that read the code, after the reporter's machine was OOM-killed** while using magpie as a gateway for Pi, signed in to a plugin-served provider (WorkBuddy). The reporter's own symptom: it dies with images in the request and does not die without them. Everything below is measured against the real `Fetch` path with `runtime.MemStats`, not inferred.

Context that narrows the search: the provider is a **plugin** (`Account.Agent == "plugin"`, `provider/plugins.go:340`), so `codexImagesFit` never runs — this is not the Codex image-refitting path, and nothing here is about decoding an image. It is about moving its bytes.

## A request's body is base64-encoded a second time on its way to the host, at 4x

`pluginFetch` reads the whole body for every request a plugin-served provider makes, with no limit of its own (`provider/plugins.go:465`). It is then handed to `plugin.Fetch` as a `[]byte`, and `FetchRequest.Body` is re-declared so `encoding/json` writes it as base64 (`internal/plugin/host.go:1655` onward). The whole params — the body included — is marshalled into one line (`host.go:1183`), and then `append(b, '\n')` copies that line again (`host.go:1187`).

Measured, `json.Marshal(params)` for one fetch, with a Responses turn carrying an image:

| base64 image in the body | body | allocated by the marshal | ratio | line on the wire |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 MB | 1.0 MB | 4.0 MB | 4.0x | 1.3 MB |
| 2 MB | 2.0 MB | 8.0 MB | 4.0x | 2.7 MB |
| 8 MB | 8.0 MB | 32.0 MB | 4.0x | 10.7 MB |
| 32 MB | 32.0 MB | 128.0 MB | 4.0x | 42.7 MB |

Dead linear at 4.0x: 1.33x for the base64 of the body, and the `bytes.Buffer` `json.Marshal` grows doubling it on the way. Then the `append` above adds the whole line once more. (The base64 of the body is not a base64-of-base64 — the inner image URL's own base64 is text by then, and text stays 1 byte to 1 byte.) At the far end `host.js` decodes it again and makes a UTF-8 string of it (`host.js:2358-2362`).

The peak heap of one fetch through the real path, above idle:

| image | body | peak heap |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 MB | 1.0 MB | 2.7 MB |
| 8 MB | 8.0 MB | 24.0 MB |
| 32 MB | 32.0 MB | 96.0 MB |

## The queue those lines wait in counts entries, not bytes

`writeReq` is `{b []byte; done chan error}` (`host.go:490`) — no size. The queue is `make(chan writeReq, callLimit())` (`host.go:953`), and `callLimit()` is `streamLimit() + rpcReserve` = `64MB/512KB + 64` = **192 entries**. `enqueueOwned` waits only for an empty slot, never for bytes.

So what it may hold is 192 times whatever one line is:

| entries queued | image | what the queue holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 192 | 1 MB | 256.5 MB |
| 16 | 8 MB | 170.8 MB |
| 8 | 32 MB | 341.4 MB |
| 192 | 8 MB | ~2.0 GB by the same ratio |

**That last row is not arithmetic here: a test that queued 192 lines of 8 MB frames was killed by the OOM killer** (`signal: terminated`) before it could report. I lowered it to get the other rows.

## Nothing upstream bounds how many of these run at once

`gateway.go:545` starts `&http.Server{ReadHeaderTimeout, IdleTimeout}` — no `MaxHeaderBytes`, no `ConnState` gate, and there is no semaphore or `errgroup` anywhere in the tree (the only concurrency limit is the per-key upstream one, `provider/concurrency.go`, default 0 = unlimited, and it is taken *after* the body is read and the memory is already held). Every request is a goroutine.

So the total is (in-flight requests) × (body × ~4x for the marshal + the line) × (up to 192 queued), with no ceiling on the first factor.

Two fetches at 8 MB measured 32.0 MB above idle, four at 8 MB measured 117.4 MB — flat, ~3.7-4x the bytes uploaded, and no sign of anything holding it back.

## Why images and not text

The 4x lands on the size of the body. Without an image the body is kilobytes, so 4x is nothing and the queue's 192 slots are nothing. With images it is megabytes per request, and a handful of concurrent requests — a Pi session with subagents or tool calls in flight is enough — is gigabytes.

## What I'd suggest

I'm reporting, not proposing; you know the design best. The three that look load-bearing from here:

1. A byte bound on what the queue holds, not just entries: count `len(b)` on enqueue and make the writer wait for room, as `streamBudget` already does for the reply direction (the read side is already well bounded by `maxFrame`, `maxWireLine`, `streamWindow` and `rejectFrameLocked` — it is only this direction that isn't).
2. A cap on `pluginFetch`'s `io.ReadAll` (`plugins.go:465`), so what one request hands over is bounded at the door.
3. Something above the gateway bounding how much body is in flight at once, since the body limit is 512 MB per request (`request_bounds.go:28`) and requests are unbounded.

If the 4x is considered inherent to JSON, mentioning it in a doc would help — I could not find it written down anywhere, and it is the difference between "a screenshot costs 1x" and "a screenshot costs 4x and then waits in a queue of 192".

Happy to do any of these as a PR if you want one; I did not want to open one unasked. The one thing I am confident about is that this is reproducible: the numbers above come from the production `Fetch` and `enqueueOwned`, not from a model of them.

comments.body:
The cause of what is left: the line into the child is queued by count, not by size. `enqueueLine` puts a line into a `callLimit()`-sized channel (192 entries) and never counts `len(line)`, and a fetch's line carries the request's whole body in base64. The 4x `json.Marshal` measured in the report was already taken away by #3472 (afc99490, `fetchLine`); what stayed is a queue that may hold any 192 lines, so a handful of image-carrying requests held gigabytes.

[fix/3074-plugin-a-request-s-body](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3074-plugin-a-request-s-body), commit 466dbda7f3e34cfbfe1b59489b5835c4f1310cf6.

It charges each queued line against a 64 MB `writeBudget` (`internal/plugin/host.go`) and makes the fetch wait for the writer to take a line before admitting another; a line bigger than the budget goes alone, so a request whose body is past it still reaches the child. `tookWrite` gives back the bytes of the line the writer took. The reply direction was already bounded this way (`streamWindow`/`streamBudget`).

Not included, because both are your suggestions 2 and 3 and need a decision on which request sizes to refuse: a cap on `pluginFetch`'s read of one body, and a bound on gateway requests in flight.

Run: `TestHostQueueHoldsWriteBudget` (internal/plugin) fails with the admission removed, "a line waiting for the queue's bytes didn't happen", and passes with it, `-count=5 -race`; `gofmt -l`, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/plugin/` and `GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/plugin/` print nothing; `go test ./internal/plugin/ -count=1` is green except `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, which fails 3 of 3 on f6ed2c99 without this change.

A fork branch, ready to review; no claim on the issue.

issue.title: [Bug] Shared plugin-host stream limit causes local 502s and retry amplification under high concurrency

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What happens

In the measured 128-request batch, a single MiniMax Code account completed all requests through Magpie without errors or retries. At 192 concurrent requests, Magpie's shared plugin host starts rejecting calls locally:

```text
too many plugin calls are in flight; try again shortly
```

Routing records these refusals as HTTP 502. The gateway retries them until slots become available, so every client request can eventually return 200 while hundreds of local failures are hidden underneath.

The source confirms that these rejected attempts never reach MiniMax. This report concerns local admission/backpressure and error attribution; it does not establish MiniMax's upstream concurrency limit.

## Environment and scope

- macOS 27.2, Apple Silicon; local gateway on `127.0.0.1:3425`.
- `@magpie-community/opencode-minimax-auth` 0.1.7.
- One `minimax-code` account, alternating `MiniMax-M3` and `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`; route records confirmed the same account and the requested model.
- OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/chat/completions`, streaming, short synthetic prompts, `max_tokens: 1024`. No tools, images or real conversation content.
- Client retries disabled; Magpie's normal retries retained.
- The account's local 32-request limit was temporarily disabled for each batch and restored afterward. No account RPM setting was configured. No Magpie admission queue waits appeared in these test traces.
- At least 65 seconds between completed batches. The target provider had no other requests in Magpie during the monitored batches. Other providers were not globally stopped.
- CLI version observed at the start: 0.1.1711; installed binary observed later: 0.1.1714. I cannot assign an exact running-gateway build to every batch. The relevant `internal/plugin/host.go` is byte-for-byte identical in the two corresponding commits: `d71362afcdc2d67732505ee9e6c19739bd452559` and `68bbcc01c5017ecce6a908f24eb653019db432a1`.

## Measured results

| Concurrent requests | Client completions | Local 502 attempts | Requests needing retries | Peak overlapping output streams | Wall time |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 48 | 48/48 | 0 | 0 | 47 | 29.31s |
| 64 | 64/64 | 0 | 0 | 61 | 33.72s |
| 96 | 96/96 | 0 | 0 | 93 | 35.79s |
| 128 | 128/128 | 0 | 0 | 120 | 36.62s |
| 192, simultaneous launch | 192/192 | 298 | 65 | 119 | 50.84s |
| 192, starts staggered by 30ms | 192/192 | 258 | 65 | 114 | 44.30s |

The 192-request simultaneous batch had 127 successful first attempts and 65 local refusals. Every failed attempt carried the exact plugin-host message above; there were no provider 429s in these batches. The local failures with a recorded duration took 1–28ms.

The stream-overlap metric runs from the first visible content/reasoning event to stream end. It is a lower bound on overlapping execution, not GPU scheduling telemetry. The count of 127 first-attempt successes is observed. We did not determine why the initial successful-attempt count was 127 rather than the nominal 128-slot capacity; other providers were not globally stopped.

## How to reproduce

1. Use a plugin-backed provider that can serve enough concurrent requests. Temporarily remove its lower account concurrency gate in an idle test setup.
2. Launch 128, then 192 streaming requests with a barrier, alternating the two models. Drain each SSE response to completion and inspect every routing attempt, not only the final HTTP status.
3. Use a small synthetic request such as:

```json
{
  "model": "minimax-code/MiniMax-M3",
  "stream": true,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Synthetic concurrency test. Write 80 distinct numbered sentences about everyday objects, each 9 to 14 words. Start at 1 and continue in order. Do not summarize."
  }]
}
```

4. Leave approximately a minute between completed batches. Repeating 192 with a 30ms launch stagger still reproduced the local refusals.
5. Restore the original account limit afterward; mine is back at 32.

## Code path

The Go-side plugin host has a separate stream budget:

- [Budget and derived limit](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/68bbcc01c5017ecce6a908f24eb653019db432a1/internal/plugin/host.go#L131): `streamBudget = 64 MiB`, `streamWindow = 512 KiB`, so `streamLimit() = 128`. The additional 64 RPC slots are reserved and cannot admit more streams.
- [Shared host](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d71362afcdc2d67732505ee9e6c19739bd452559/internal/plugin/host.go#L552): calls obtained through the current host share its channels; this limit is not per provider or per account.
- [Admission](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/68bbcc01c5017ecce6a908f24eb653019db432a1/internal/plugin/host.go#L1444): `begin(true)` immediately returns `errTooManyCalls` when the stream channel is full.
- [Fetch ordering](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d71362afcdc2d67732505ee9e6c19739bd452559/internal/plugin/host.go#L1685): admission happens before dispatch to the plugin child, so a rejected attempt has not reached the vendor.
- [Lifecycle](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/68bbcc01c5017ecce6a908f24eb653019db432a1/internal/plugin/host.go#L313): receiving headers does not release the slot. The call remains counted while its response body is consumed/drained; `releaseSlot` returns it on the released transition.

This earlier Go-side gate is reached before Bun's separate fetch concurrency limit. I did not find a CLI/configuration option for the stream budget.

## Expected behavior

Keep the bounded memory budget and RPC reserve, but handle its saturation explicitly:

- Apply bounded, cancellable backpressure at the shared host boundary, or return a distinct local-capacity result with an appropriate retry hint instead of a generic 502.
- Show that the capacity is local and shared across plugin-backed providers/accounts. Per-account concurrency settings alone do not describe this boundary.
- Avoid repeatedly treating local admission refusal as a vendor failure. Local saturation should not penalize upstream health or cause unnecessary provider fallback.
- If the budget is intended to be configurable, expose/document it together with its memory cost and safe bounds.

Related: #3074 discusses plugin transport memory and queue accounting. This report adds a live reproduction of the shared stream admission limit and the resulting local 502 retry amplification.

Only synthetic request statistics and public code references are included; no credentials, account identifiers, private endpoints or conversation logs are attached.

issue.title: plugin host: gatewayBegin 对未修改请求（no-op）的 magpie.hooks 仍执行全量 structuredClone 与 18 次 JSON.stringify 防篡改校验，长上下文下把 magpie-bun 推到 cgroup 上限

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 摘要

任何已启用插件在 `package.json` 里声明 `magpie.hooks`（#2118 引入的异步请求钩子）之后，`HasGateway()`（`internal/plugin/gateway.go:132-146`，`v0.1.1819` 与 `v0.1.2891` 行号一致）就全局返回 `true`，于是**每一个 agent 请求体——完整历史、系统提示词、工具定义——都会跨进程进入 Bun 插件宿主、在宿主里被深拷贝、并为防篡改校验逐字段序列化**，包括那些钩子最后什么都没改的请求。

本问题在 `gatewayBegin` 请求钩子链路上，与 #3074 / #4004 讨论的 provider `fetch` 路径（body 被 base64 二次编码 4x）互补，不是同一处。

`HasGateway()` 为真时，`GatewayBegin` 把整个 body 交给宿主（`internal/plugin/gateway.go:206`，两个 tag 完全一致）：

```go
	err = h.call(start, "gatewayRequest", map[string]any{"operation": "begin", "body": json.RawMessage(body), "context": info}, &out)
```

一个只想在某一种协议上补一个顶层字段的插件，要为网关上的全部流量付这份钱。

### 宿主内部的开销

`internal/plugin/host.js` 的 `gatewayBegin`，逐字摘录（`v0.1.1819` 为 `1353-1369` 行；`v0.1.2891` 为 `1456-1472` 行，代码一字未改）：

```js
      const result = await bounded(Promise.resolve().then(() => h.onRequest(structuredClone(body), ctx)), ownSignal)
      let next = body
      if (result !== undefined) {
        if (!result || typeof result !== "object" || Array.isArray(result)) throw new Error("invalid body")
        // Validate serialization before accepting a plugin's result.
        next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result))
        if (!next || typeof next !== "object" || Array.isArray(next)) throw new Error("invalid serialized body")
        if (outcome === "skipped") outcome = "ready"
      }
      // Context hooks cannot register or change client tools or tool choice,
      // nor the model or streaming: the gateway checked the caller's key
      // against the model, and the client reads the reply it asked for.
      for (const key of ["tools", "tool_choice", "function_call", "functions", "toolConfig", "model", "stream"]) {
        if (JSON.stringify(next[key]) !== JSON.stringify(body[key])) throw new Error("context hook changed client tools, model or streaming")
      }
      if (JSON.stringify(next.config?.tools) !== JSON.stringify(body.config?.tools) || JSON.stringify(next.config?.toolConfig) !== JSON.stringify(body.config?.toolConfig)) throw new Error("context hook changed client tools")
      body = next
```

由此得出三点：

1. **校验循环在 `if (result !== undefined)` 之外。** 钩子返回 `undefined` 时，`let next = body`（`:1354` / `:1457`）使 `next` 与 `body` 是同一个引用，随后的循环仍把 `tools`、`functions`、`toolConfig` 等 7 个顶层键加 2 个 `config` 子键各序列化两遍——**合计 18 次 `JSON.stringify`**，纯粹拿一个大字符串和它自己比。Claude Code 一类客户端的 `tools` 数组常有几百 KB。
2. **`structuredClone(body)` 对每个钩子无条件执行。** 入参本身就是这条 RPC 消息刚 `JSON.parse` 出来的、只属于本次请求的对象树，克隆之后插件还没跑，堆里已经同时驻留两棵完整大树。
3. **返回新 body 的钩子再付第三棵树**：`JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result))`，回传 Go 时还要再序列化一次。

### 实测

用 magpie 自带的 Bun（1.4.2，x64，Windows）复刻上面这段序列，请求体按长上下文 agent 轮次构造（40 条消息 + 45 个工具定义），单次请求相对 wire JSON 的峰值 RSS 增量：

| wire JSON | 钩子返回 `undefined` | 钩子返回修改后的 body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.9 MB | +3.7 MB（~4.2x） | +6.3 MB（~7.1x） |
| 2.5 MB | +11.0 MB（~4.4x） | +17.4 MB（~7.0x） |
| 6.5 MB | +20.3 MB（~3.1x） | +32.9 MB（~5.1x） |

**物理页滞留**：一次 4.6 MB 请求走完修改路径后 RSS 峰值 64.8 MB；强制两轮 `Bun.gc(true)` 后 `heapUsed` 降到 14.2 MB，RSS 只回落到 48.1 MB。也就是说常驻内存棘轮到「迄今最大的一次请求」而不是「当前活着的数据」。

另有一例**用户报告**（非本机测量）：Linux x64 容器、cgroup `mem` 上限 640 MiB，`magpie-bun` 在一夜之间被 `CONSTRAINT_MEMCG` 连续强杀多次，被杀时 `anon-rss` 约 627 MB。（内核日志里的 `total-vm 6.38GB` 是 JSC 预留的虚拟地址空间，不是占用，关键量是 `anon-rss`。）

### 插件侧已经做的绕行，以及它的局限

触发这个问题的插件是 `magpie-ua-switcher`，它的钩子原先给 Claude Code 类中转站补 `metadata.user_id`。该插件已在 v1.8.0 移除 `magpie.hooks`，改写 provider 的 `extraBody`（`internal/provider/extrabody.go`，自 `v0.1.1191` 起支持），由 Go 侧在请求发出前合并，`HasGateway()` 因此回到 `false`。

这解决了这一个插件。它救不了下一个确实需要异步请求体钩子的插件：是否把 body 送进宿主的决定在 Go 侧做出，而 Go 无从知道钩子关心哪类请求，插件也无法为自己不处理的请求省掉入程与深拷贝。

### 改进建议

1. **把校验循环移进 `if (result !== undefined)`**（`host.js:1365-1368` / `1468-1471`）。`result === undefined` 时 `next === body` 按构造恒成立，跳过即 100% 保持现有行为，省掉每次 no-op 请求上的 18 次序列化。若仍想要一道保险，比较引用（`next !== body`）就足以知道有没有东西需要校验。
2. **先定「就地修改」契约，再裁剪 `structuredClone`。** 现在传 `structuredClone(body)` 保证了一件事：钩子若就地改了入参却返回 `undefined`（或抛错、超时），这些改动会被丢弃。直接删掉克隆会静默改变这条语义。若要在保留 fail-open 隔离的前提下不再双树常驻，宿主可以只对受保护字段做快照，或在返回 `undefined`/出错时回退用原始 RPC JSON 字符串，而不必预先克隆整个 `messages`。
3. **允许钩子在 `package.json` 声明作用域与体积上限**，让 `GatewayBegin` 在跨 stdio 之前就能决定：

   ```json
   "magpie": { "hooks": { "main": "./hooks.mjs", "protocols": ["anthropic"], "maxBodyBytes": 2097152 } }
   ```

   `GatewayContext` 已带 `protocol`（`internal/plugin/gateway.go:82-92`），而调用点 `internal/gateway/middleware.go` 的 `gatewayHooks`（`v0.1.1819:111-127`，`v0.1.2891:153-172`）在 `GatewayBegin` 之前就已经算好了它。

### 环境

- magpie `v0.1.2891`（同时核对 `v0.1.1819`；除行号偏移外，上文代码完全一致）。
- 插件宿主运行时：magpie 内置 Bun 1.4.2。
- 探针测量：Windows x64。容器 OOM 部分为用户报告的 Linux x64 现场，非本机复现。

issue.title: plugin host: gatewayBegin 把整个请求体放在一行里回传，超过 maxWireLine（32 MB）就杀掉共享宿主，所有插件 provider 上正在进行的请求一起断开，并反复重启

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现象（v0.1.3327，macOS arm64）

2026-11-08 15:50–18:25（UTC+8）这段时间里：
- `plugin: host starts` 出现了 268 次（15 点 21 次，16 点 101 次，17 点 53 次，18 点 93 次）。
- 不同调用方（pi、other）在不同插件 provider（WorkBuddy、Qoder CN、QwenWork、Loomy、商汤小浣熊、AutoClaw）上的请求，一起报：

```
gateway: pi's call to group/tier-main on workbuddy failed: 200 after 8.458s: WorkBuddy: connection lost mid-reply (the plugin host sent a line longer than 33554432 bytes)
gateway: other's call to group/tier-fast on qoder-cn failed: 200 after 15.432s: Qoder CN: connection lost mid-reply (the plugin host sent a line longer than 33554432 bytes)
```

- 每次宿主重启前，都有 gateway 钩子插件的超时告警：

```
plugin [warn]: @magpie-community/gateway-nowledge-mem@latest: gateway request hook failed or timed out; keeping request
plugin: host starts with no proxy ...
```

同一个现象 2026-11-06 16:08 也出现过一次（`group/nowledge-bg on minimax-code`）。

## 原因（按 v0.1.3327 和当前 main 的源码，两处一致）

1. 只要有插件声明了 `magpie.hooks`，`HasGateway()` 就返回 true。之后每个请求都会走 `GatewayBegin`（`internal/plugin/gateway.go:206`），把完整 body 发给宿主。
2. 宿主的 `gatewayBegin` 最后 `return { id: run.id, token: run.token, body }`（`internal/plugin/host.js:1631`），再由 `send({ id: msg.id, result })` 用一次 `JSON.stringify` 写成一行。钩子没改请求、甚至超时（"keeping request"）时，也会把原 body 整个写回去。这条回包不像 fetch 的 `chunk` 帧那样分片。
3. Go 侧读宿主 stdout 时，单行上限是 `maxWireLine = 32 << 20`（`host.go:182`）。超过就走 `errLineTooLong` → `h.fail(...)` + `h.kill()`（`host.go:1283-1287`），整个共享宿主被杀掉。
4. 所有插件 provider 共用这一个宿主，所以正在进行的请求不管属于哪个 provider，都会以 "connection lost mid-reply" 失败。客户端重发同一个大请求时，宿主会再被杀一次，于是形成重启循环。

`maxWireLine` 的注释写的是："a frame's base64 is well under it, and so is any RPC result"。但 gatewayBegin 的 RPC result 里装的是整个请求体，这个前提对它不成立。

## 影响

一个超大请求（长会话、带内联截图的历史等）就能让所有插件 provider 一起失败几个小时。后台调用方（我这里是 Nowledge Mem 的蒸馏任务）收到的是 "dispatch outcome unknown"，也就是不知道上游有没有真正执行。

## 建议

- 钩子没改 body（返回 undefined）或超时时，`gatewayBegin` 只回 `{id, token, unchanged: true}`，Go 侧继续用原 body。这也能顺带解决 #5168 里说的拷贝和序列化开销。
- 改了 body 的情况，回包要么用和 fetch 一样的分片帧，要么在 Go 侧对超过上限的 gateway 回包只放弃这一次钩子（等同 "keeping request"），不要杀掉整个宿主。
- 可选：请求体超过阈值时直接跳过 gateway 钩子，并记一条日志。

相关：#5168（同一条链路的性能问题），#3074 / #4004（fetch 路径上 body 的编码开销）。

## 未确认的部分

我不知道当时是哪个请求超过了 32 MB，本地没有抓到请求体大小。上面的结论来自日志里的错误类型、发生时间和源码路径；并没有用一个已知大小的请求复现过。
